common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art sprite for a tiny first-person dungeon crawler, inspired by Eye of the Beholder and Dungeon Master. Make only ONE isolated sprite, no sprite sheet, no border, no labels, no text, no floor, no background, no drop shadow. Genuine transparent alpha. Draw at the indicated tiny logical resolution, enlarged with hard square pixels: chunky clusters and bold readable silhouettes, no tiny speckle, no smooth painting, no antialiasing. Dark black-paper dungeon aesthetic. Warm light from above and toward the viewer. Restrained palette: charcoal #0b0a08 #151614 #322b2b; gray steel and stone #3d3a36 #515349 #63655c #7a7c72 #94968c #b0b2a8, maximum nonemissive highlight #cdcfc6; dark brown wood #1a0e07 #331a0c #452712 #582b13 #684629 #784620 #924f1d #a97639; parchment #be914b #d8a95e #e2cb8b. Only actual flames may use #431e0f #7a4a12 #a8341f #ecb64a #f6b450 #f7ca58 #fbd070. No white, no blue steel, no neon, no decorative glow. Put readable shape and value contrast ahead of fine detail.

sprites.hand_sword_idle: Logical canvas 40x48, portrait. First-person view of the leading knight's RIGHT hand, seen from the knight's own eyes, at the bottom-right corner of the screen. Steel plate gauntlet with four broad finger plates wrapped firmly around a dark longsword grip; visible thumb, short crossguard, dark chain-mail cuff. Only one hand and one longsword. Sword blade rises from the fist up and slightly to the LEFT; long straight double-edged steel blade, thick readable mid-gray body and one narrow pale gray edge. Map composition to this logical canvas: point near (14,1), crossguard centered around (23,30), fist around (28,35), wrist around (31,43). The wrist and chain-mail cuff continue straight off the bottom edge, occupying x25 through x39 at the bottom. Cuff must touch and be clipped by the bottom edge; no detached arm and no fully floating object. Most of upper-left canvas is transparent. Compact robust armor, no gold ornament, no skin.
sprites.hand_sword_raise: Logical canvas 40x48. Use the supplied idle hand as the reference for the identical steel gauntlet, chain-mail cuff, blade width, longsword and pixel style. Draw a NEW raised attack-ready pose: right fist higher and drawn back toward the RIGHT; crossguard around (25,22), fist around (30,28), straight sword blade tilts back toward the UPPER RIGHT with point around (37,1). The wrist curves down to the exact same fixed bottom cuff anchor as idle: x25 through x39 at y47, clipped by the bottom edge. Only one hand and one blade. The raise pose must differ visibly from idle; blade is tilted right, not left. No motion streaks in this ready frame.
sprites.hand_sword_swing: Logical canvas 40x48. Use the supplied idle hand as the reference for the identical steel gauntlet, chain-mail cuff, blade width, longsword and pixel style. Draw a NEW mid-swing attacking pose: the right fist high on the right around (31,26), crossguard around (26,23), straight blade sweeps diagonally DOWN and LEFT toward its point around (1,38). Two or three separated short muted pale gray motion streaks trail behind the blade, never white. Show the fist gripping the hilt beyond the crossguard, so this reads as a sword swing, not a floating blade. Wrist bends into the exact same fixed bottom cuff anchor as idle: x25 through x39 at y47, clipped by the bottom edge. Most upper-left is transparent. Only one sword, one right hand.
sprites.hand_torch_a: Logical canvas 24x40, tall. First-person LEFT hand at the bottom-left of the screen, seen from the knight's own eyes. Steel plate gauntlet with dark chain-mail cuff, clearly wrapping around a dark wooden torch shaft. Broad finger plates and readable thumb; no skin. Shaft rises roughly vertically at x11, with wrapped soot-dark torch head around (11,15). Tall lively flame centered around (11,8), separated tongues and a bright gold core, ember red edges, no white. The cuff runs off the bottom edge at x0 through x14. Fist centered around (9,29). Cuff touches and is clipped by the bottom edge. Upper corners transparent. Single left hand, single torch. Firm broad silhouette, warm gray highlights on armor from the flame.
sprites.hand_torch_b: Logical canvas 24x40. Use the supplied torch A as a strict reference for the entire left gauntlet, cuff, shaft, torch head, colors and placement. The hand, wrist, shaft and torch head must remain identical. Change ONLY the flame into a second flicker frame: lean its tallest tongue to the right and split its left tongue lower, change the yellow core shape visibly, same overall flame scale and brightness, no white. Flame occupies the upper portion above the wrapped torch head; hand remains at the bottom-left with cuff clipped off the bottom at x0 through x14.
sprites.campfire_a: Logical canvas 24x20, landscape. A SMALL campfire seen from a little above: a low oval ring of about seven chunky charcoal-gray stones, two visibly crossed dark-brown logs inside, orange-red and muted golden flames rising in two or three broad tongues. Fire centered and readable, pointed flame tops, bright gold interior but no white. Low stone ring across bottom third, logs visible below flame. No ground or cast shadow, outside shape fully transparent. Preserve clear gaps in the irregular stone silhouette. Entire object fits inside the canvas with a narrow transparent margin.
sprites.campfire_b: Logical canvas 24x20. Use supplied campfire A as strict reference: identical stone ring and crossed logs at identical locations. Change ONLY the flame tongues and yellow core for a clearly different second flicker pose, tallest tongue leans the other way. Flames remain orange-red and muted golden, no white. Low oval stones seen a little from above. No ground or cast shadow, transparent outside, entire object fits with narrow transparent margin.
sprites.boulder: Logical canvas 24x18, landscape. Single rough cave boulder seen a little from above, asymmetrical squat mound with jagged chipped outline and three or four broad planar faces. Upper face warm pale gray #7a7c72; middle faces #515349 #63655c; underside charcoal #151614 #322b2b. Two broad irregular dark cracks, a few chipped planes; large shapes, no grain or tiny dots. Clearly solid rock, not masonry and not a jewel. Full object fits inside canvas with a narrow transparent margin, no ground or shadow.
sprites.lectern: Logical canvas 24x30, portrait. Single wooden lectern seen from the front and slightly above, supporting a big OPEN TOME, with one small lit candle BESIDE the book on the viewer's right. The open book is the largest feature in the upper half: two broad warm parchment pages forming a shallow V, visible dark center gutter and brown cover, only two or three thick dark page marks per page, no actual text. Clearly sloped wooden desktop below the book, stout single pedestal and broad foot at bottom. Candle beside book, not inside it: muted wax, tiny orange-gold flame, dark holder. Dark brown wood with a few warm upper-facing edges, gray-charcoal underside. Bold readable silhouette. Entire object fits with thin transparent margin, no ground or cast shadow.
sprites.chest: Logical canvas 20x16, landscape. A closed iron-bound medieval treasure chest seen from the front and slightly above, squat rectangular dark wooden body, slightly rounded CLOSED lid, two thick gray iron straps wrapping vertically over lid and front, dark metal horizontal lid seam and prominent central square latch. Brown plank planes with simple broad shading, pale gray warm highlights on the upper iron edges. No gems, no gold, no opening, no contents. Entire object fits with narrow transparent margin, no ground or cast shadow. Make the closed lid and front latch very readable at 20 pixels wide.
